2607.11215.title: Q-BridgeNet: A Quantization Network for Cross-Lingual Sign Language Translation
2607.11215.paper_summary: Most sign language translation (SLT) methods focus on isolated native sign-spoken pairs (e.g., American Sign Language - English). Extending language-specific SLT models to multilingual translation would improve accessibility by enabling communication across diverse sign and spoken language communities. However, existing multilingual SLT approaches still struggle to learn a unified model that minimizes cross-lingual conflicts while capturing shared cross-lingual semantics and preserving language-specific variations across different sign languages. Therefore, we propose Q-BridgeNet, a unified framework for multilingual SLT that jointly mitigates cross-lingual conflicts across both the sign language and spoken language sides. On the sign language side, Q-BridgeNet learns discrete Q-units via adaptive segmentation and residual vector quantization: a shared base codebook provides language-agnostic semantic primitives, while language-specific residual codebooks refine heterogeneous signing semantics. On the spoken language side, a multilingual LLM is fine-tuned to operate in the Q-unit space, leveraging cross-lingual priors to enable a unified SLT model. Experiments on PHOENIX14T, How2Sign, and CSL-Daily show that Q-BridgeNet effectively mitigates cross-lingual conflicts, achieving state-of-the-art performance on native sign-spoken pairs while also demonstrating strong generalization to non-native pairs. Our source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/FengLiQ/Q-BridgeNet
2607.11215.paper_summary_zh: 大多數手語翻譯（SLT）方法專注於孤立的母語手語-口語對（例如，美國手語 - 英語）。將特定語言的 SLT 模型擴展到多語言翻譯將通過促進不同手語和口語社群之間的交流來改善可及性。然而，現有的多語言 SLT 方法仍然難以學習一個統一的模型，以最小化跨語言衝突，同時捕捉共享的跨語言語義並保留不同手語之間的語言特定變異。因此，我們提出了 Q-BridgeNet，一個統一的多語言 SLT 框架，旨在共同減輕手語和口語兩側的跨語言衝突。在手語方面，Q-BridgeNet 通過自適應分段和殘差向量量化學習離散的 Q 單元：一個共享的基本代碼本提供語言無關的語義原語，而語言特定的殘差代碼本則細化異質的手語語義。在口語方面，一個多語言 LLM 被微調以在 Q 單元空間中運作，利用跨語言先驗來實現統一的 SLT 模型。在 PHOENIX14T、How2Sign 和 CSL-Daily 上的實驗顯示，Q-BridgeNet 有效減輕了跨語言衝突，在母語手語-口語對上達到了最先進的性能，同時也展現了對非母語對的強大泛化能力。我們的源代碼已公開可用於：https://github.com/FengLiQ/Q-BridgeNet
